entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Virtualize regression in .NET 11: Home and End typed in a text input jump the list to its first or last item #70554
  • Virtualize regression in .NET 11: fractional row heights stop the window following the scroll and leave the viewport blank #70553
  • [Review Agent Failure] Missing review-thread resolution metadata in feedback.json leads to re-litigating resolved threads #70551
  • [Review Agent Failure] Intentional test/sample opt-outs and secondary-failure exception suppression certified as defects #70550
  • [review-pull-request] Pass sibling-worker refutations to review-candidate-verifier and validate remedies against in-repo tests (#70497) #70548
  • [review-pull-request] Calibrate review-candidate-verifier external/unestablished handling and exclude unestablished DROPs from inline publication #70547
  • [review-pull-request] Stop publishing contradicted [DISCARDED] candidates as inline GitHub PR review comments #70546
  • Enforce stricter boundary checks in MultipartReaderStream #70545
  • Virtualize regression in .NET 11: wheel scrolling runs ahead by whole windows in a div scroller when hovering a row changes its layout #70541
  • Virtualize regression in .NET 11: a list that grows while scrolled jumps towards its end, then ignores scripted scrolls and scrollbar drags #70540
  • [API Proposal] Add the online and offline events to the typed browser platform APIs for Blazor #70529
    .NET 12 Planning
  • Move source-build container to Azure Linux 4 after Arcade trailing-backslash fix #70524

Closed

  • Query-component validation (#68320) not backported to release/10.0: HTTP/2 :path query with SP/HTAB/CTL still accepted on .NET 10 LTS #70508
